Name: Batman Craftables
Author: Fragezeichenbox
Description:
Team Leichenmeister is greeting all of you. We, Shin-Arei and Colaris (former Fragezeichenbox), are happy to help you Batman lovers out with some sprites. Just drop the folder in Mods and you're ready to go.

[b]Version 1.0.0[/b]

This mod changes some 'Craftables' and 'Furniture' sprites in the TileSheets folder as well as some descriptions. The following changes include at the moment:
-       Default craftable scarecrow to ‘Batman the Animated Series Scarecrow’
-       Scarecrow from the Stardew Valley Fair (Fall 16) for 800 tokens to ‘Tim Sale // Batman the Long Halloween Scarecrow’
-       Spirit's Eve Festival scarecrow (Fall 27) for 5,000g to ‘Batman Year One Scarecrow’
-       Festival of Ice for 5000g or at Traveling Cart scarecrow during Fall or Winter season to ‘Batman Fear State’
-       Flower Dance Festival scarecrow (Spring 24) for 2,500g to ‘The New Batman Adventures Scarecrow’
-       Dwarf scarecrow for 2,500g to ‘Nolanverse // The Dark Knight trilogy Scarecrow’
-       Donate 20 artifacts to the museum or be purchased from the Night Market scarecrow (Winter 15-17) once the museum one is unlocked to ‘Batman Arkham Asylum Scarecrow’
-       Donate 40 total artifacts to the museum or be purchased from the Night Market scarecrow (Winter 15-17) once the museum one is unlocked to ‘Batman Arkham Knight Scarecrow’
-       Suit Of Armor is changed into a cool Batman armor
-       Sign Of The Vessel is now a question mark statue of the Riddler
-       Crystalarium is having a question mark on the glass
 
[b]Version 1.0.1[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-       Chicken Statue is changed to a Crow statue and now correctly working
-       Some assets were corrected in size

[b]Added:
[/b]-       Custom names and text to:
﻿- Suit of Armor = Armor of Batman
﻿- Sign of The Vessel = Sign of the Riddler
﻿- Chicken Statue = Crow Statue
﻿- Crystalarium = Riddler Machine
-       Update Notes


To be added soon:
-       Rarecrow craftable after collecting every other Rarecrow in the game to ??? (Still open, we let the Users/Fandom decide on Tumblr)
-       Casino for 10,000 Qi coins. The only scarecrow who can wear hats will be changed to ‘First Appearance Scarecrow’
-       Interface to switch on and off the mod

Have fun with the mod.
